David R. Liu.notes: Six+ long podcast interviews plus recorded lectures. Founder of nine companies incl. Editas, Beam, Prime. His lectures narrate design reasoning step by step - the richest single target in the genetic-medicine group.

Fyodor Urnov.notes: Coined 'genome editing' in 2005 at Sangamo. 100+ papers, 130+ patents. Also writes NYT op-eds. Known for extended automotive metaphors - his explanatory style is itself the artifact.

Michael J. Sofia.notes: 'Enter Sofosbuvir: The Path to Curing HCV' (Cell 2016, Lasker essay, free PDF) is a first-person design narrative - liver-targeted nucleotide prodrug logic laid out in full. Plus a book chapter 'The Discovery of Sofosbuvir'. Best-documented single molecule on the list.

Michael S. Brown.notes: Nobel 1985 with Goldstein. Their joint Nobel lecture and 50-year retrospective document a scientific partnership as a working method. A 2020 book covers their NIH start.

Joseph L. Goldstein.essay_series: Annual Nature Medicine Lasker supplement essays, 2000/2001-present
Joseph L. Goldstein.notes: KEY: chairs the Lasker Awards jury since 1996 and has written an annual Nature Medicine essay series since ~2000 on creativity, elegance and taste in science - what makes an experiment 'elegant' or a body of work 'beautiful'. That series is one of the best explicit statements of scientific judgement in the corpus and needs collecting in full.

Helen H. Hobbs.notes: JCI 'A conversation with Helen Hobbs' includes video. Named lecture series: TNQ Distinguished Lectures 2019 (three cities), Harvard Bloch Lecture 2019, 107th Ricketts Lecture 2022. Dallas Heart Study outlier method is the reasoning to capture.

Daniel J. Drucker.notes: glucagon.com has served for years as the field's central repository - his own curated archive of foundational studies and integrative reviews. Highest-value self-maintained resource of anyone in the metabolic group.

Lotte Bjerre Knudsen.notes: 'Inventing Liraglutide' (ACS Pharmacol Transl Sci 2019) is a first-person invention account - C16 albumin-binding fatty acid side chain, then C18 diacid plus a DPP-4-resistant substitution for semaglutide. Acquired ACQ2 episode is a long-form design narrative. 2024 Lasker.

Richard D. DiMarchi.notes: 20 years at Lilly Research Labs; discovered the active peptide of Humalog. The GLP-1/GIP single-molecule dual-agonist insight became tirzepatide. Shared the 2024 Bhaumik award with Knudsen. No dedicated lecture video located.

Steven M. Paul.notes: The KarXT story is a clean case of reasoning about a shelved asset: xanomeline's M1/M4 agonism worked but peripheral cholinergic side effects killed it at Lilly; pairing with trospium (does not cross the BBB) rescued it 25 years later. Paul inherited the molecule at Lilly and later built the company around it. Ex-Lilly EVP science and technology / president of Lilly Research Labs; also co-founded Sage.

John Hardy.notes: 1991 first APP mutation implicated in Alzheimer's, leading to the amyloid cascade hypothesis. ALZFORUM is the place his running commentary and revisions live - worth crawling as a venue, not just his page. Breakthrough Prize 2016, Brain Prize 2018, knighted 2022.
